title: Cup of Tea Red
style: Warm lo-fi boom-bap with laid-back swung drums at 88 BPM, dusty bass, Rhodes stabs, and a tight loop that settles into a focused head-nod; verse rides clipped drum-bar and intimate pocket, pre-chorus strips to bass and tea-kettle hiss, chorus hits with warm chords and doubled chant hook. Lead vocal stays close-mic and calm, with soft doubles on the anchor line, ad-lib echoes in parentheses, a vinyl crackle bed, tape stop into the bridge, and a bright yet dusty mix with cozy low-end warmth., theme, lo-fi, warm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Red in the system, no time to drift
Cup stays warm while the commits hit
I’m in the flow, got the cursor lit
Hands on the keys, I don’t miss
Stack in the background, tailscale locked
One repo now, everything docked

[Pre-Chorus]
No gaps left, everything pulled in
Sharp on the edge while the work begins
Tea in the mug, steam in the air
Keep it moving, I’m already there

[Chorus]
Red on the desk, tea in the cup
Signal is live, I don’t need to rush
Red on the desk, tea in the cup
Red keeps the edge while the work gets done
(tea in the cup)
(red on the desk)

[Verse 2]
Lint on the line, I trim it clean
Small little fixes, make the whole thing breathe
Tasks fall in place, one by one
Quiet little wins till the day is done
Cup stays warm by the keyboard glow
I take my time, but I keep it close

[Pre-Chorus]
No gaps left, everything pulled in
Sharp on the edge while the work begins
Tea in the mug, steam in the air
Keep it moving, I’m already there

[Chorus]
Red on the desk, tea in the cup
Signal is live, I don’t need to rush
Red on the desk, tea in the cup
Red keeps the edge while the work gets done
(tea in the cup)
(red on the desk)

[Bridge]
One more pass, then I breathe
Hold that line, let it keep me
Less noise now, more control
Steady hands, steady soul

[Final Chorus]
Red on the desk, tea in the cup
Signal is live, I don’t need to rush
Red on the desk, tea in the cup
Red keeps the edge while the work gets done
(tea in the cup)
(red on the desk)
